{{Quote|Greetingzzz, Master. How may Drone Beegee-Arfivetoo zzzervice the colony, hive, or zzzocial collective?|Start-up greeting from a new J9 worker drone|<ref name="NEGTD" />}}
'''Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines''', more commonly referred to as simply '''Roche''', was a technology manufacturing program operated by members of the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] species. Based in the [[Roche asteroid field|Roche asteroids]], the program was in direct competition with other technology companies, and struggled with entering the galactic market. Initially, Roche achieved only limited success with its insect-like droid designs. Later designs, such as the [[Siak-series protocol droid|''Siak''-series protocol droid]], were developed with humanoid customers in mind, and thus appealed to a far larger customer base. By [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Roche had expanded into the field of [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] manufacturing.

Despite being one of the most successful non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] droid manufacturers, Roche had trouble competing with other, larger companies, and was thus forced to distribute nearly exclusively in the Roche asteroids and aboard [[Ithorian Herdship]]s.

==History==
===Product development===
Given the success of other [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] technology efforts (such as [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]]) and the species' tendency towards technophilia, it was only natural for them to eventually branch out into [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing.<ref name="Cynabar" /> Thus Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines was founded by Verpine some [[Time/Legends|time]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|sports/1344_1.html|Nuna-Ball League Looks to Expand}}</ref>

One of Roche's first designs, the [[J9 worker drone/Legends|J9 worker drone]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], was a disaster. The droid strongly resembled its Verpine creators, spoke in a buzzy, [[Insect/Legends|insect]]-like manner, and frequently worked words such as "royal jelly" into its translations. This alienated most potential customers, especially those of [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The few J9s that were sold often ended up doing menial tasks; its "worker drone" title confused buyers into thinking it was a [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]].<ref name="NEGTD" />

Roche had more success with later, more humanoid-looking designs such as the [[8D smelter droid]]<ref name="NEGTD" /> and the [[Siak-series protocol droid|''Siak''-series protocol droid]]. For the ''Siak''-series, Roche hired Human engineers to develop both the chassis and personality matrix, hoping to avoid the design flaws that kept humanoids from purchasing the J9. The result was a sales success.<ref name="Cynabar" />

===Mandalorian allies===
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Shab'', a ''Mando''-Verpine assault fighter. That'll cause some sleepless nights on Coruscant.|[[Medrit Vasur]]|<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>}}
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Roche representative [[Sass Sikili]] secured a deal with the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]], where Roche would receive [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] in exchange for technology [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] could use for their new ''[[Bes'uliik]]'' [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. At the same time, Roche was involved in a copyright dispute with the government of [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]], which had started manufacturing patented Roche technology. Representatives of Murkhana heavily criticized Roche's deal with the Mandalorians, accusing the company of using bullying tactics to force Murkhana to stop production.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

After it was made clear that Murkhana would not receive any aid from the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], Roche threatened military action if Murkhana did not halt production of the technology that breached Roche patents. When Murkhana failed to comply, Roche and its new Mandalorian allies prepared to bomb Murkhanan factories with their new starfighters.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

===Confrontation with Sith Empire===
Several years before the start of the [[Ossus Project]], Verpine engineers, having endured subjugation by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the past, designed the [[IX-6 heavy combat droid]] to deter incursion into the Roche asteroid belt. When the [[Fel Empire|new Empire]] became a force to be reckoned with, Roche increased the production of the IX-6 droids and spread them throughout Verpine hives, as well as continued to sell them to other interested parties. After the establishment of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], Roche was ordered by Imperial officials to immediately cease the production of the IX-6 and destroy all existing models. Unwilling to succumb to the Empire, Verpine spread the factories throughout the Roche [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt, hiding them deep in the asteroids which appeared abandoned from the surface. When the Empire learned of the defiance, a fleet of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] blasted several heavily populated Verpine asteroids to dust. The massacre, however, did not break the will of the Verpine species and Roche continued to produce new IX-6 and smuggle them to anyone who could afford them.<ref name="LECG" />

==Products==
[[File:J9WorkerDrone-NEGTD.png|thumb|left|150px|The J9 worker drone.]]
Roche's Verpine engineers typically designed droids with insect-like appearances.<ref name="NEGTD" /> After learning that this was detrimental to sales, they started designing more humanoid droids. Their droids were regarded as quite dependable and cheap, a trait appreciated by many customers.<ref name="AEG Extras">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021017web|text=''Arms & Equipment Guide'' Extras!}}</ref> Roche models were typically either [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol]] or [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]], though they were known to have manufactured at least one maintenance droid.<ref name="Cynabar" />

Roche's first attempt at a protocol droid was the aforementioned J9 worker drone. While unpopular with most species, Roche successfully marketed it towards other arthropods, such as the [[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]].<ref name="NEGTD" /> Their successor protocol droid model, the ''Siak''-series, addressed some of the major complaints with the J9, and thus sold in larger quantities.<ref name="Cynabar" />

Labor droids designed by Roche included the [[11-17-series mining droid]], a joint project with Slayn & Korpil. The 11-17 was a sales failure&mdash;the model's individual droid brain was considered an unnecessary expense by most customers. The 8D smelter droid was a small revolution for the metal processing industry: prior to this extremely heat-resistant droid, most work was performed by automated equipment. The introduction of the 8D meant that several steps of the metal processing process could be streamlined.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> The [["Hatchling" maintenance droid]], Roche's only known second degree droid model, was a versatile and cost-efficient repair unit that could be modified to perform a variety of tasks.<ref name="Cynabar" />

The company was also responsible for developing a number of technologies that had practical appliances in spacecraft manufacturing. This technology was extensively used in MandalMotors' ''Bes'uliik'' starfighter.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Roche2.jpg|thumb|The alternate Roche logo.]]
Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines first appeared in [[West End Games]]' roleplaying sourcebook ''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''. Most mentions of the droid manufacturer have come from other roleplaying supplements and the two [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|Essential Guides]] on droids.<ref name="Cynabar" />

The Roche logo shown in ''Cynabar's Fantastic Technology'' differs from the one used in the Essential Guides&mdash;it consists only of the word "ROCHE," written with [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]] characters, in white on a black background.<ref name="Cynabar" /><ref name="NEGTD" />
